gauge.name: Little Satilla River near Offerman

impacts.statement: Extensive inundation of structures and roads along the river basin. Evacuations of people or transfer to higher ground is likely.
Some inundation of structures and roads along the river basin can be expected. Evacuations of people to higher ground is possible.
Flooding on low lying roads, docks and campgrounds along the river basin can be expected.
Should water levels continue rising, preparations to protect property should begin.
